test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight classmates D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight row, facing north. J is at the extreme right end of the row. D and I are immediate neighbours. There are only two classmates sitting between H and D. Only E sits between I and G. K sits to the immediate left of D. Who sits at the second position from the left end of the row?
solution:
**Given: **

Eight classmates D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 

**Solution:**

(1) There are only two classmates sitting between H and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d8920720cefe9cd7ddbdf07ba04cf2e33f3c69929e7781c8edbdfff32dd75b9.png] 

(2) K sits to the immediate left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d01dea7be983abe8bdee9b9b9e5dba93e67c7b9ac508c345dcb2d5360f485014.png] 

(3) D and I are immediate neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a56c0d1560f93a8bc2b55a099aad5fab1da2ca03dd3db0ed5ca1bfce9113d872.png] 

(4) J is at the extreme right end of the row.

(5) Only E sits between I and G.

 
• Only case 1 is possible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1aff8e35034f5b2b37b8964f2c547a4e8fba93eabca349bb295ae00ca690ef8d.png] 

(6) unoccupied seat will be filled by F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eaa0e3e18ba827575833790cd60b4c72d9bcfa51e89f16b41f6f362604c5efe.png] 

Here, **F** sits at the second position from the left end of the row.

**Hence, 'option 2' is the correct answer.**
